description: On the table in front of you there’s a small yellow cup, a gray plastic bin with some clear ice pieces inside, and a purple scoop off to the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the yellow cup as a left-hand object, lifts it toward the bin, tilts and rotates it to dump the ice pieces into the gray bin, then straightens the cup and sets it back down while the right hand stays nearby without touching anything.
